verdict.rationale: There is some evidence of versioned APIs. Vue publishes a 'Migration from Vue 2' guide and a 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2' page, which together imply distinct major versions and a support transition for the old one. A community comment also praises how the public API was redesigned while keeping users happy, but nothing in the pack spells out a deprecation policy, timelines or semver guarantees. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation policy, stated versioning/semver guarantees, documented support windows or end-of-life timelines, and independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled.
